body.name: Saturated order-indexed response architecture list
body.construction: For each topological order \(\prec\) on \(W\), form one saturated super-architecture \(T_{\prec}\).  It contains every directed input slot \(i\to j\) with \(i\prec j\) and one potential independent source \(U_C\) for every nonempty \(C\subseteq W\), incident to every \(j\in C\).  Absence of a directed input or source incidence is encoded by the corresponding equality \(Z_e=0\); activity is encoded by \(Z_e>0\).  Thus there are at most \(A_{\max}=N!\) labeled super-architectures.  Give every potential source at most \(K_{\max}=m+3\) slots, including zero-mass slots, and enumerate every dense deterministic response table; the number of table systems for one order is at most \(R_{\max}\).  For each table system retain precisely the essential-feature sign patterns whose selected latent projection is a graph \(G\in\mathcal G(\mathcal P)\).
